# Developer handoff

Observed at: <UTC ISO timestamp>; display timezone America/Phoenix. Actor: <role>. Active change: <CHG-ID and status>.

- Objective and authorized scope: <tasks/requirement IDs; Director decisions still required>.
- Repository: <actual location, branch, reachable HEAD, remote, dirty files and owner>.
- Execution: <discovered Dev Container/Compose project, toolchain; never assume old container IDs>.
- Implemented behavior: <feature IDs, public contracts, state/lifecycle changes, reserved work>.
- Documentation: <updated and reviewed-unchanged documents with reasons; current map/snapshot>.
- Verification: <RUN IDs, exact category, command, outcome, code/signal, source fingerprint, limits>.
- Listeners/resources: <owned processes and ports, how to stop/restart; protected data/resources>.
- Pending gates: <real device, access, prerequisite or Director acceptance; do not infer completion>.
- Next actions: <concrete tasks, prerequisites and acceptance criteria>.

Preserve failures and interrupted work. Link exact records and use the same schema as the changelog. Update before leaving or transferring work; never claim a live process without observing it.
